name: Finland
contextBlurb: Finland applies MiCA to stablecoin issuance and crypto-asset services. Fiat-referenced stablecoins are permitted when authorised as EMTs or ARTs and subject to EU reserve, redemption, white paper, governance and AML obligations. FIN-FSA is the main national financial supervisor.

legislation.title: Markets in Crypto-Assets Regulation (MiCA)
legislation.summary: Directly applicable EU stablecoin framework for EMTs and ARTs.

stablecoinMeta.summaryEn: Finland follows MiCA. Stablecoin activity is legal with EU licensing, reserve, redemption, disclosure and AML restrictions.

regulators.name: Finnish Financial Supervisory Authority
regulators.role: National financial supervisor responsible for MiCA implementation and crypto-asset service oversight in Finland.
